instruction.description: User instruction for this writing task; always the highest priority.

material.description: Source material excerpts assembled by the caller, mainly for draft-create.

roomId.description: Optional legacy scope id; omitted = workspace document scope.

materialSources.description: Source document blocks (from the caller's document_read) that back the draft; cite them as block index marks. roomId is optional (omitted = workspace scope). For draft-edit this includes rewrite requests that only append index marks to existing paragraphs.

roomTitle.description: Optional legacy scope title for context framing.

roomId.description: Optional legacy scope id injected by the gateway; omitted = workspace document scope.

documentId.description: Target document id, injected by the gateway for draft-edit and draft-continue.

documentMarkdown.description: Authoritative document snapshot assembled by the gateway, for draft-edit and draft-continue.

documentTruncated.description: True when documentMarkdown was truncated at the assembly budget.

blockIndex.description: Top-level block index of the snapshot; draft-edit targets must reference these blockIds.

outline.description: Heading outline of the document snapshot.

baseVersion.description: Document version of the snapshot; must be echoed in the result for draft-edit and draft-continue.

selectedText.description: The selected fragment to rewrite, required for rewrite.

contextBefore.description: Document text before the selection, style context only.

contextAfter.description: Document text after the selection, style context only.

blockType.description: Markdown block type of the selection, e.g. heading, bulletList, codeBlock.

formatContext.description: Editor format context of the selection (marks, list nesting, code language).

responseLanguage.description: BCP-47 language tag for natural-language output.

writingStyle.description: Trusted writing-style guidance section injected by the gateway; the user instruction always takes priority.

previousInvocationId.description: Incremental iteration: references the previous doc-writer invocation whose output is supplied below.

previousDraft.description: Your own output from a previous invocation in this conversation (title line + draft body). Apply the instruction as a delta on it: keep untouched parts stable and output the full revised product, do not rewrite from scratch.
